name: Bond market volatility
summary: Treasury volatility at the 100 Watch line; 10-year yield near 4.95%
state: The MOVE index of Treasury volatility was about 100 on 3 Nov, at the Watch threshold, and the US 10-year yield rose to about 4.95% from 4.91% during the day (Yahoo Finance), about 32bp below its level a month ago. The Treasury's quarterly refunding (4 Nov) and October payrolls (6 Nov) are the next tests.
for_you: Higher and more volatile bond yields feed through to mortgage and loan rates, particularly in the US.

sources.title: Yahoo Finance — S&P 500, Nasdaq snap 3-day losing streaks as chip stocks rally

why: US Treasuries price almost every asset on earth; when the 'risk-free' market becomes volatile, funding and collateral chains strain.
drivers: Inflation data, Fed path, deficits and auction demand, foreign holder flows, liquidity.

rubric.alert: MOVE > 140, or disorderly Treasury trading (failed/tailed auctions with Fed action, emergency buybacks).
rubric.watch: MOVE 100–140, or US 10y moved ≥ 40bp in a month, or weak auctions flagged.
rubric.normal: MOVE index < 100 and US 10y moved < 40bp over the past month.
